title: Polyline delivery generator
description: Encode/decode polylines on a map and generate pickup/dropoff orders along the route as CSV.

title: Images → PDF
description: Turn a set of pictures (e.g. comic pages) into one PDF: reorder, catch non-PNG files and mismatched sizes, preview pages, download.

title: Sticky note wall
description: Cut a picture into a grid of sticky notes, apply dither, halftone or B/W, and print it piece by piece: an empty grid first, then one pass per sheet.

title: Dither Photo
description: A Game Boy Camera–style web camera: live dithered preview, 4-tone palettes, front/back camera, one-tap save of a 512×512 PNG.
